messages:
Alex Ruiz: Quick postmortem follow-up: we're seeing a repeated 'stutter' pattern on chat endpoints — short partial token bursts, 2-6s silent gaps, then resume. Likely interaction between client reconnect jitter, server rate-limiter, and KV-cache cold-starts. Need owners and short timeline.

Maria Ng: I'll own observability. Tasks: add inter_chunk_gap_ms per-session metric, 95p & median histograms, tag alerts with 'partial-response'/'stutter', link to session traces. ETA: EOD Thu.

Kevin Choi: I'll own runtime experiments. Plan: canary extend handshake timeout 2s->6s; add trace to detect KV-cache reseed on reconnect; try skipping reseed for reconnects within 8s. Run canary Fri AM.

Sarah Li: I'll prep a draft customer note for any impacted beta users and sync with support. Hold release until mitigations validated.

Alex Ruiz: Short-term mitigation proposal: reduce rate-limiter aggressiveness for established sessions (warm windows), publish SDK recommendation for reconnect jitter + capped backoff, and push minor SDK patch if helpful. Target: SDK note by Wed next week.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-9902 created for tracking, assigned to #incidents.

Kevin Choi: Sample log snippet showing pattern:
```
[2026-03-22T09:11:02Z] session=xyz chunk=12
[2026-03-22T09:11:03Z] session=xyz chunk=13
[2026-03-22T09:11:07Z] session=xyz chunk=14  <-- 4s gap
[2026-03-22T09:11:09Z] session=xyz chunk=15
```
Also seeing correlated tail on nodes with mixed quantization profile.

Maria Ng: I'll run a synthetic: 500 concurrent sessions @1t/s and a second test with bursty input to reproduce backpressure-induced gaps. Will surface node_id/model_variant correlations.

Alex Ruiz: Timeline/checkpoints: obs work by Thu EOD (Maria), canary/runtime diffs by Fri AM (Kevin), synthetic tests Thu midday (Maria), SDK guidance + short-term rate-limiter tweak next Wed (Alex), comms draft Fri (Sarah). Follow-up sync Mon 11:00 PT.

Sarah Li: For incident taxonomy, suggest adding labels: 'recurring-stutter', 'partial-response', 'kv-coldstart'. That will help aggregation across past incidents.

Kevin Choi: I'll instrument a boolean in traces if reconnect triggered full KV reseed. If true in >10% of reconnects tied to gaps, that's a smoking gun.

Maria Ng: I'll add alert: if session inter_chunk_gap 95p > 3000ms over 10m AND count(sessions with gap)>5, page oncall. Dashboard link posted here when ready.

Alex Ruiz: Ownership summary: Maria (obs & alerts), Kevin (runtime canary & KV tracing), Alex (SDK guidance & short-term rate-limiter change), Sarah (comms). Please add checkboxes & ETAs to INC-9902. If patterns span node_id or regions, escalate to eng-infra.

oncall-bot: Reminder: next follow-up meeting Mon 11:00 PT.

Kevin Choi: ACK. Will post canary results and PR link in thread.

Maria Ng: ACK. Dashboard + alert rules will be here shortly.

Sarah Li: ACK. Draft comms will be in the ticket for review.

Alex Ruiz: Thanks team. Also: consider a weekly recurring review for incident recurrence detection until we stabilise (add to cadence).
